Sampling 60 of these against RIDB's per-campsite catalog: 21 real RV campgrounds (3+ public RV sites), 19 no catalog at all (FCFS - unknown, not 'no'), 19 no RV sites (tent/cabin/boat-in), 1 with 1-2. Floor ~205 real, realistic ~250-350.

state is inferred from the NEAREST existing DB entry, not from RIDB. Rows flagged coord_suspect had nothing within ~130 km, which in practice means RIDB's own latitude/longitude is corrupt (e.g. Big Reservoir Campground, really Tahoe NF CA, listed in the Pacific off Baja). Re-pin those from the agency before judging them.

The name filter that produced this list is keyword-based, so a few survivors are still day-use or duplicate facilities (Caesar Creek Lake is the USACE listing for a lake whose camping is the state park already in the DB).
